Evan R: quick postmortem follow-up from the late-night alert storm. goal: stop repeat pages for known noisy signals without losing fidelity for real regressions.
Mina H: yes please. minimal blast radius.
Evan R: Proposed short plan: 1) raise p95->p99 for bulk paths for 30 days as a trial; 2) add per-service dedupe with signature; 3) add label-driven suppression for scheduled jobs; 4) start a biweekly 4-alert sweep for 8 weeks.
Kai L: I can own the dedupe + signature format. plan: 3m collapse window + 20m suppression for identical signature. signature = "{{service}}:{{endpoint}}:{{error_code}}". will test in staging.
Mina H: i'll run the percentile analysis on 60-day data and propose concrete cutoffs. 24h turnaround.
Evan R: sample alert snippet for staging (for Kai to use):
```
alert: svc_endpoint_err_p99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service, endpoint, error_code)) > 0.4
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: paged
annotations:
  signature: "{{ $labels.service }}:{{ $labels.endpoint }}:{{ $labels.error_code }}"
```
alert-bot: (automated) Incident#5120 closed by evan.r  created follow-up task 'noise-surgery-5120'
Evan R: owners & deadlines: Kai L - dedupe + PR + staging tests due 2025-08-05; Mina H - thresholds PR due 2025-08-04; Evan R - canary plan + runbook blurb due 2025-08-06.
Kai L: will add "tuned-aug2025" label to tuned alerts and include a visible banner for 2 weeks in Slack notif.
Mina H: will include expected page reduction % and a short FN risk note in PR.
oncall-bot: Reminder - please add triage steps to alert defs and link runbook.
Evan R: agree. one extra rule: do NOT suppress alerts during deploy-tagged events. Kai add whitelist for deploy tags.
Kai L: ack. will post PR link + staging logs here when ready.
Mina H: ack. posting analysis CSV and dashboards in thread once complete.
Evan R: final: reply 'got it' once you've added tasks to the board so I can move them to In Progress.
Kai L: got it
Mina H: got it
Evan R: thanks team. I'll ping oncall before canary and post rollback steps.
